title: Which town has the higher median onion price?
description: The twelve onion prices of each town are sorted, and the two middle prices give each median. The video then checks that each median has six prices on either side.
teaching_notes: One idea: with twelve values there is no single middle, so the median is halfway between the sixth and the seventh sorted values. Watch for students who skip the sorting or pick the sixth value of the unsorted list.

source: Find the median of onion prices in Yahapur and Wahapur
video_script.why: The child has found both towns' means and now finds the medians by sorting, as with the batters' runs.
video_script.substitution: Sorting brings the two middle prices together, and halfway between them is the median.
video_script.payoff_line: Wahapur has the higher median, thirty eight point five rupees per kilogram.

final_answer.spoken: Yahapur thirty seven rupees, Wahapur thirty eight point five rupees per kilogram

maths_rules: check: Yahapur has 6 prices below 37 and 6 above; Wahapur has 6 prices at most 38 and 6 at least 39
means were about 38.17 for Yahapur and 37.5 for Wahapur, so the order flips
